tldr: EVIDENCE CEILING (read first): the session web-search budget was exhausted (200/200, session-wide) after 38 successful searches (16 extended), below the 40 minimum; 4 more were refused. Every competitor/media host returned EGRESS_BLOCKED (org egress policy, not retried; 28 hosts listed in data/competitors.json _meta). Zero competitor pages were read directly, so every competitor fact is 'per search summary' at low/medium confidence. All deliverables are marked status: draft and should be re-run after the cap is raised and the hosts are allowed (re-run query list in Appendix B of the doc).

Census: 32 profiled competitors (7 with numeric fee/SLA facts, 25 with product/positioning facts only), 13 named-only, 4 adjacent entities. 18 sell cards/FX payments/Perfect Money, 14 sell gift cards/subscriptions. hyper-acc, digitalro and paybal.ir could not be found (paybal.ir does not resolve). 345+ of 510 JSON records are honestly null/UNVERIFIED with verify_how (enamad, payment methods, support hours, loyalty, bots, complaints, numeric re-pricing lag are unknown for nearly all).

Reference rates 2026-10-02 (10 Mehr 1405, Friday): free-market USD 258,465 IRT (outlets cluster 258,465-259,900), official exchange-centre USD sell 174,704 IRT on 2026-10-01 => free/official premium +47.95%; USDT ~256,900 IRT (lead's research).

Visible fee structures (all low confidence, per summary): Dollarisho USD 10 issuance, USD 10 min load, 4% fee + 2.99% FX conversion on a live Bonbast rate; Tehran Credit Card 2%+4% = 6% (USD 1k-3k) and 2%+3% = 5% (>USD 3k); Almas Payment fixed USD 18 (<USD 1k) / USD 50 (>=USD 1k) + usage fee 1% (cap USD 5) + opaque 'specified transfer rate'; generic FX-gateway band 2-5% (a 2024 article, stale). Six fee archetypes defined (A pass-through % fee, B house rate + fixed fee, C Toman price list, D bid/ask spread, E incumbent trust brand, F gray cheap accounts).

ChatGPT Plus (USD 20; parity 5,169,300 IRT): official-like listings 5,539,100 / 6,400,000 / 6,596,200 / 8,890,000 IRT = +7.15% / +23.81% / +27.60% / +71.98% over parity (n=4, median +25.71%, p10 12.15, p90 58.66; indicative only). A gray tier at 0.989-1.3M IRT (-75% to -81% vs parity) is a different, high-risk product. Seller-to-price mapping was not available (8 candidate stores).

KEY FINDING for pricing/treasury: using the lead's cost model at zero margin, our break-even for a USD 100 load is +6.95% over free USD (3% provider fee assumed, 2% risk buffer) versus visible competitor fees of 4-6%. Matching Dollarisho's 4% needs a provider top-up fee of ~0.13% (or ~2.14% with zero risk buffer). Lowest official-like Plus price is 4.05% BELOW our modelled break-even. Either rivals mark up the rate, fund much cheaper (e.g. netting cash-out and payment flows, which Arzipay/IraniCard/Safir both sell), or run thin margins: must be settled with same-day all-in quotes before any price list is fixed.

Positioning: of 54 listed page titles 24% claim speed, 26% price, 4% authenticity/trust, 2% a guarantee, so trust/guarantee/transparent all-in quote/SLA/restriction disclosure (only Almas discloses) is the open lane. Marketing channels seen: sponsored Zoomit/Zoomg/Digiato articles (>=11 brands, IraniCard through Sept 2026), business news, SEO landing pages/blogs, Android app stores, comparison sites (IranBroker, FxPay, Emalls).

Customer choice model, elasticity, seasonality, market size and price-war parameters have NO empirical basis in this run: they are explicit assumptions (tagged [A], *_sim_prior records, status UNVERIFIED) with low/base/high and sensitivity: firm-level price elasticity -10 (-5 to -20); speed and trust premiums 10% (3-25); blended 8% undercut => ~2.3x share until matched; reseller-served GMV model USD 474m/yr (p10 186m, p90 1,200m; deterministic 60m/414m/2,512m), revenue pool USD 27m (9-80m), ~40k orders/day industry (16k-101k), new brand year-1 GMV ~USD 2.3m. Tornado: buyers count and spend per buyer dominate. No dated price-war episode was found; mechanisms pw-1..pw-5 and undercut headroom (-0.9 to -3.0 pp on percentage-fee loads if rivals price at market; +14 pp on Plus at the median) are provided.

Reproducible pipeline: scripts/research/07_markup_stats.py is deterministic (seeded, no numpy, verified identical across runs and cwd), computes markups, fee curves, cost-floor headroom and sensitivity via the lead's pricing_model, title-claim counts, elasticity grids and the market model, accepts an optional data/raw/competitor_observations.csv (mystery-shopper template documented), and --write refreshes markup_stats/market_size/elasticity/price_war derived blocks in data/competitors.json. Section 8 of the doc is a lawful 2-hour mystery-shopper protocol (own identity, no referral farming or chargeback abuse).

Hygiene: I did not commit or push. My `rm -rf __pycache__` briefly deleted two git-tracked .pyc files in other areas; I restored them with git checkout and set sys.dont_write_bytecode in my script so it never dirties them again.
